reviewer.independence_scope: Separate agent read-only review of plan, captured bytes, job inputs/process receipts/replies, result accounting and timing. Does not claim independent human scientific review.

scope: Retained authored-development demonstration only. Existing results reviewed without algorithm execution. Earlier source reading informs limits; this audit does not prove source-to-model fidelity or algorithmic novelty.
limits: Eleven authored development profiles, not held-out tasks or qualified domains.
Direct baseline and reference share the same disclosed implementation module.
Unknown cases remain uncertified and are retained in coverage accounting.
No human review, live admission integration, novelty, performance advantage or 70 percent project completion established.
execution.json is an immutable start record; summary.json and the parent result.json carry terminal status.
Timing totals sum worker invocations including certificates and reference; parent-runner overhead is excluded.
